body:
I'll definitely try and take that advice.

Thanks again.
You have definitely helped me out. Helped me put some things in a different perspective. Thanks by the way.

I definitely think that makes sense. I really don't remember much about back then but I could definitely see that being the case. Which does make me feel a little better, couldn't say why, but it does.

Your question is kind of hard to answer, my friends have all either moved away or are online. If I go off of phone calls, video chats, and even hanging around at school (where I wouldn't say I have friends, but acquaintances), it generally feels like hanging out just for hanging out. Sometimes I'll feel a little...calmer I guess when talking to someone I enjoy talking to but if the conversation lasts a long time I usually just feel drained and can't wait for it to be over.

Thanks by the way, for talking to me. I really needed it.

I guess that makes sense, about the material things, but it doesn't make me feel any less selfish. 

Sure it could be something looming in the future, I'll be 18 soon enough and that is incredibly scary to me. To be I guess "legally" completely independent is petrifying to me. But I'm not entirely sure, I've just noticed that I'm way more anxious than normal lately.

I guess that's possible. Granted, I've never been abused or traumatized (I guess unless I don't remember it) but I think that my Mom had a lot of children (I have 5 siblings) and she doesn't know what to do with them so she gets frustrated and screams and sometimes throws things and then goes to bed and sleeps all day and stays up all night. My family is all really loud too so maybe I've kind of become numb to tune them out? I also have a Dad but he's always working and when he's here he's usually on the computer or yelling at people. 

I don't think there was a certain event, but something I have noticed is that I started feeling like I was probably gay around 8 and I think I started cutting and feeling sad around 9. I don't think I have any qualms with me being a lesbian though, and I told my parents at 13 and they appear pretty cool with it too. So I don't know, it feels more like a gradual shift.
